description.value: SOY Asian Fusion Restaurant is a family-owned spot in Kelowna's Pandosy Village, opened in 2011 by Tokyo-trained chef Takeshi Ishizaka and his wife Tomo. The menu draws from Japanese, Korean, and broader Asian traditions — highlights include Spicy Coconut Ramen, Chicken Karaage, and Korean BBQ — with dedicated gluten-free and vegan menus. The licensed dining room pours sake, beer, and local BC wines, and the restaurant also offers delivery through Skip the Dishes, DoorDash, and Uber Eats.
